title: MISAG: Minimum Information about a Single Amplified Genome
description: Standardized metadata for single-amplified genomes (SAGs), covering assembly quality, completeness, contamination and contextual fields aligned to MIxS.
keyFeatures: Quality tiers for SAGs (completeness/contamination); Required contextual metadata aligned to MIxS; Supports repository validation and comparability
practicalUse: Use MISAG fields when generating or curating SAGs from surveillance samples to ensure comparable quality metadata.
